message: Added a statewide turnout map, current-election precinct maps, local-time update history, and expandable voting schedules. Historical precinct maps are hidden.

Added daily in-person and mail counts for Loudoun County in the November 2020, 2021, and 2022 elections. Fairfax County figures are unchanged.

Added weather across all 133 localities for every tracked election; aligned daily chart dates, trimmed empty endpoints, enlarged historical comparisons, and enabled clean URLs. Added 2020 history for ten more localities; remaining historical imports are pending.

Completed November 2020 daily histories for all 133 localities, preserving Fairfax. Added comparison timeline and ballot-type filters, regional and locality-size/density summaries, and shoreline-corrected overview map.

Added election comparisons on the homepage and locality pages, a compact regional table, alphabetical locality sorting with region filters and turnout bars, unclipped map tooltips, and chart date bubbles. Historical charts now default to election day.

Simplified turnout summaries and locality tables; added automatic comparable-election insights and a homepage historical chart; changed cumulative ballots to lines; added aligned hover details, holiday badges, daily totals, and clearer filters.

Renamed the site VoteFlow; simplified homepage tables and sorting; enabled all historical comparisons with in-person and mail pace tables; added sortable daily data, transposable site charts, and grouped voting schedules with explicit historical uncertainty.
Standardized source naming as Daily Absentee List and Archived voting data; updated import and refresh paths while preserving voting data and source precedence.
